scripts.dev: TREEPORT_DATA_DIR="$PWD/.treeport-dev/data" TREEPORT_DATABASE_PATH="$PWD/.treeport-dev/data/treeport.db" TREEPORT_RUNTIME_DIR="$PWD/.treeport-dev/runtime" TREEPORT_API_URL="$(pnpm exec portless get api.treeport)" TREEPORT_DESKTOP_URL="$(pnpm exec portless get treeport)" NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="${PORTLESS_STATE_DIR:-$HOME/.portless}/ca.pem" pnpm exec portless --script watch
scripts.dev:direct: TREEPORT_DATA_DIR="$PWD/.treeport-dev/data" TREEPORT_DATABASE_PATH="$PWD/.treeport-dev/data/treeport.db" TREEPORT_RUNTIME_DIR="$PWD/.treeport-dev/runtime" TREEPORT_HOST=127.0.0.1 TREEPORT_PORT=4780 TREEPORT_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4780 TREEPORT_DESKTOP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 pnpm exec turbo run dev
scripts.watch:web: cd apps/web && if [ "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir)" = "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)" ] && tailscale status >/dev/null 2>&1; then portless treeport --tailscale vite; else portless treeport vite; fi
scripts.clean: find apps packages -type d \( -name dist -o -name dist-types \) -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && rm -rf .turbo
